Race data

Each recorded race is also sent to the game's developer to help balance ships, weapons and tracks. No names: other pilots in a room go as Pilot 1, Pilot 2 and so on. Switch it off any time.

Music is synthesised live, with drum hits and effects from the Sonic Pi sample pack (freesound.org recordings, public domain under CC0). The announcer and sung chops use the open Kokoro speech model (Apache-2.0).
